overrides.title: Student overrides
overrides.description: Extra time, extra attempts or a different window for one student. The server applies an override when that student starts an attempt.
overrides.emptyDescription: Add one below to give a student extra time, extra attempts or a different window.
overrides.noStudents: No enrolled students to choose from.
overrides.timeMultiplierHelp: 1 keeps the normal time limit; 1.5 gives 50% more time.
overrides.timeMultiplierRange: Enter a multiplier between 1 and 4, with at most two decimals (for example 1.5).
overrides.windowHelp: Leave both empty to keep the quiz window.
overrides.windowOrder: The end of the window must come after its start.
overrides.reasonPlaceholder: Why this student gets an override
overrides.removeError: The override could not be removed

removeConfirm.title: Remove this override
removeConfirm.description: {{student}} goes back to the quiz’s own time limit, attempts and window.

overrides.extraAttemptsRange: Enter a whole number of extra attempts: 0 or more.
overrides.extraAttemptsHelp: 0 keeps the quiz’s own number of attempts.
overrides.windowEnded: This window has already ended, so it would give the student nothing. Choose an end in the future, or leave both dates empty.

submissions.title: Submissions
submissions.subtitle: Every student's submission for this assignment.
submissions.subtitleCourse: Every student’s submission for this assignment in {{course}}.

grading.title: Review Submission
grading.viewOnlyNotice: You don't have permission to grade this submission.
grading.scoreHint: A percentage from {{min}} to {{max}}; up to two decimals, like 92.5.
grading.scoreRange: Enter a score from {{min}} to {{max}}, with at most two decimals (for example 92.5).

regradeConfirm.title: Replace the grade?
regradeConfirm.description: Replace the grade of {{previous}} with {{next}}? {{student}} will see the new grade instead of the old one.

grading.title: Manual grading
grading.description: Enter whole points for each question that needs a manual grade. You can save some now and the rest later: the attempt finalises and the score is computed once every question has points.
grading.pointsRange: Enter a whole number of points from 0 to {{max}}.
grading.savedFinal: Every manual grade is in. The attempt is finalised and the score computed.
grading.error: The grades could not be saved
grading.viewOnly: You don’t have permission to grade this attempt.
grading.complete: Every manual grade is in; this attempt is finalised.
grading.unavailable: Grading is not available for a voided attempt.
grading.noneEntered: Enter points for at least one question before saving.
grading.savedPending_one: Saved. {{count}} question still needs points before the attempt finalises.
grading.savedPending_other: Saved. {{count}} questions still need points before the attempt finalises.

signals.title: Worth a look
signals.description: Facts from this attempt’s timeline that a reviewer may want to check, each with the events behind it. They are prompts for a conversation, not proof: Atlas does not decide whether anyone broke the rules, and some ways of breaking them — a phone, another person in the room — leave no trace here.
signals.none: Nothing in this attempt’s timeline stood out.

time_away.title: Quiz page hidden
time_away.summary_one: The quiz tab was hidden once, for {{total}}.
time_away.summary_other: The quiz tab was hidden {{count}} times, {{total}} in total (longest {{longest}}).
time_away.innocent: Locking the screen, a phone call, a break, briefly switching to another app.

focus_lost.title: Another window in front
focus_lost.summary_one: Another window had focus once while the quiz stayed visible, for {{total}}.
focus_lost.summary_other: Another window had focus {{count}} times while the quiz stayed visible, {{total}} in total (longest {{longest}}).
focus_lost.innocent: Notifications, a second monitor, screen readers or magnifiers, system dialogs.

fullscreen_left.title: Left full screen
fullscreen_left.summary_one: Full screen was left once, for {{total}}.
fullscreen_left.summary_other: Full screen was left {{count}} times, {{total}} outside it in total (longest {{longest}}).
fullscreen_left.innocent: Pressing Esc by accident, a system prompt, the operating system taking over the screen.

fullscreen_never_entered.title: Never in full screen
fullscreen_never_entered.summary: The quiz required full screen, but the browser never reported entering it.
fullscreen_never_entered.innocent: An outdated app or a browser extension; or the learner continued without full screen after their browser refused it.

fullscreen_unavailable.title: Full screen unavailable
fullscreen_unavailable.summary: The browser reported that full screen was not available ({{reasons}}).
fullscreen_unavailable.innocent: Some browsers have no full screen for web pages (every browser on iPhone, for example), and a browser setting can block it. A modified browser could also claim this.

paste_without_copy.title: Pasted text from elsewhere
paste_without_copy.summary_one: Text was pasted once without being copied in this quiz first.
paste_without_copy.summary_other: Text was pasted {{count}} times without being copied in this quiz first.
paste_without_copy.innocent: Dictation and other assistive input tools, text prepared earlier where allowed.

paste_after_copy.title: Pasted own text
paste_after_copy.summary_one: Text was pasted once after being copied within this quiz.
paste_after_copy.summary_other: Text was pasted {{count}} times after being copied within this quiz.
paste_after_copy.innocent: Usually moving one’s own words between answers.

copy.title: Copied text
copy.summary_one: Text was copied or cut once.
copy.summary_other: Text was copied or cut {{count}} times.
copy.innocent: Copying one’s own answer; selecting text while reading.

connection_gap.title: No contact from the browser
connection_gap.summary_one: Nothing arrived from the browser for {{total}}.
connection_gap.summary_other: Nothing arrived from the browser {{count}} times, {{total}} in total (longest {{longest}}).
connection_gap.innocent: A dropped connection, a laptop going to sleep, a closed tab, a battery saver pausing the page.

policy.monitor_one: This attempt ran in monitor mode: events were recorded silently (limit {{count}} event).
policy.monitor_other: This attempt ran in monitor mode: events were recorded silently (limit {{count}} events).
policy.warn_one: This attempt ran in warn mode: the learner was warned from the first recorded event (limit {{count}} event).
policy.warn_other: This attempt ran in warn mode: the learner was warned from the first recorded event (limit {{count}} events).
policy.strict_one: This attempt ran in strict mode: it was to be submitted automatically at {{count}} recorded event.
policy.strict_other: This attempt ran in strict mode: it was to be submitted automatically at {{count}} recorded events.

events.title: Event timeline
events.description: Everything recorded during this attempt, in the order the server received it. Ignored events fell inside the warm-up or debounce window and did not count.
events.empty: No events were recorded for this attempt.
events.notMonitored: Integrity monitoring was not enabled for this attempt, so nothing was recorded. This is different from a monitored attempt with no events — enable integrity on the quiz (and, if it is not yet available for this academy, ask the platform to turn it on) to record tab switches, copying, pasting, printing and leaving fullscreen.

void.title: Void this attempt
void.description: Voiding marks the attempt invalid, removes its result and refunds the attempt to the student. The reason is recorded.
void.reasonPlaceholder: Why this attempt is being voided
void.reasonRequired: A reason is required to void an attempt.

confirm.title: Void the attempt?
confirm.description: Attempt {{number}} by {{student}} will be voided. This cannot be undone.

void.alreadyVoided: This attempt has already been voided.
void.viewOnly: You don’t have permission to void this attempt.
